title: Inspect and extend: A movie record and a useful catalogue
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Models.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve movie fields, identity, movieinfo projection, and seed records.
problem: A catalogue row stores facts that screens need. Read the Movie model and seed entries, then see how a compact detail projection is derived. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Models.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Models.swift; Sources/Core.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to movie fields, identity, movieinfo projection, and seed records.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The displayed catalogue is seeded sample data; live movie-service access is not configured.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A catalogue row stores facts that screens need. Read the Movie model and seed entries, then see how a compact detail projection is derived.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Models.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
